answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by anchoring identity to a hardware beacon whose electrothermal feedback noise signature is physically unclonable, isolating each node as a thermal island with a unique phonon-scattering fingerprint. Peers verify this fingerprint through an echo challenge that replays calibrated bias pulses and checks the measured transition-edge. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
